inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors or 50 lateral feet of overhead transmission conductors are not from Utility Compatible Shade Trees list, or site grading does not meet required clearances from transmission facilities
inputs.question: Are there any overhead electric lines shown on the landscape plan? If so, what trees are proposed within 10-50 feet of these lines and are their species identified?
inputs.regionHint: Check entire site and note any utility line routings through landscaped areas

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/discovery question (are OHE lines shown at all, and are tree species identified in labels/tables), which is a prerequisite step before any measurement or compatibility assessment can occur. The actual clearance measurement and species-list compliance check would come later.
